implemented: Version 3 authored recipes with atomic complete replacement, preview, receipts, revision guards, retirement and undo/redo.
Bounded sorted catalog queries and frozen runtime catalog inspection with session/tick/revision guards.
Shared native recipe validation, custom schema consumers, and deferred literal entity-reference liveness.
Template-only model and texture dependency closure, relocation without import sources, and frozen catalog save/restore without replacing authored edits.

qualification.Windows: This catalog change has not yet been cross-built or executed on Windows.

limits: No public runtime spawn/despawn or C# TemplateId API.
Root-prop subset only; no template hierarchies, animation rigs, audio emitters or GUI catalog authoring.
At most 256 recipes and 2 MiB total custom payload bytes.
Save slots retain recipes, not cooked asset bytes; required cooked content must remain available.
Relocation fixture manually copies the dependency directory; it is not an end-to-end packaged-player qualification.
